# truecast gold

> Best-in-class public work, organised by job, for agents to find, compare and hold their work against. Plain text, CC0. Linked works belong to their owners; every entry links the owner's copy and an Internet Archive snapshot.

How to use this catalog:
1. Find the job: match the request against the job titles and aliases below (or grep jobs/ for a word). If the request is several jobs, look in Playbooks first.
2. Check scope: each job lists size siblings (smaller / larger / alternative). Pick the right size before picking gold; a tweak held to PRD gold gets over-written.
3. Read the job card, then the 2-3 shelf entries whose `context` best matches the brief. Shelf order is the curator's rank; context fit comes first.
4. Follow `relations` (same_system, contrast, explained_by) before mixing sources from different systems. A job's `contrast` entries are weak or wrong-size examples kept for comparison: never model on them.
5. If the shelf is empty, use the card's required_shape and check, and say that no gold was available.
6. Open the linked original (or the archive snapshot) before claiming what it contains.

Status: prototype, 2026-11-05. All entries are agent-drafted and unratified.

## Entries

- [dropbox-brand-guidelines](entries/dropbox-brand-guidelines.md): Dropbox Brand Guidelines — Dropbox · artifact/document · jobs: brd-014 · context: software, digital-first, public guidelines site · use when: writing guidelines for a software brand that lives mostly on screens.
- [ibm-8-bar-logo](entries/ibm-8-bar-logo.md): IBM 8-bar logo — Paul Rand for IBM, 1972 · artifact/visual · jobs: brd-006 · context: established company, enterprise, print and screen, one-color · use when: an established company wants a typographic mark that must survive one-color reproduction.
- [linear-write-issues](entries/linear-write-issues.md): "Write issues not user stories" (Linear Method) — Linear · artifact/document · jobs: pm-051 · context: small change, software team, any stage · use when: the change is a tweak; step up to pm-007 only if it needs goals, non-goals and metrics.
- [mailchimp-brand-assets](entries/mailchimp-brand-assets.md): Mailchimp brand assets page — Mailchimp · artifact/document · jobs: brd-014, brd-015 · context: public press and partner page, minimal · use when: you need a press kit or public brand page (brd-015), not internal guidelines.
- [mailchimp-content-style-guide](entries/mailchimp-content-style-guide.md): Mailchimp Content Style Guide — Mailchimp · artifact/document · jobs: brd-017 · context: software, SMB audience, friendly voice · use when: writing a voice and tone guide for a friendly, plain-spoken software brand.
- [mailchimp-rebrand-collins](entries/mailchimp-rebrand-collins.md): Mailchimp brand system case study — COLLINS · artifact/document · jobs: brd-010, brd-001 · context: scaleup, SMB software, product expansion, consumer-friendly B2B · use when: a rebrand is really a portfolio or positioning problem (brd-001), not just a logo refresh.
- [nasa-graphics-standards-manual](entries/nasa-graphics-standards-manual.md): NASA Graphics Standards Manual (NHB 1430.2) — Danne & Blackburn for NASA, 1976-01 (manual in effect January 1, 1976) · artifact/document · jobs: brd-014, brd-006 · context: large organisation, many sub-units, print-era, government · use when: writing guidelines for an organisation with many teams or sub-brands that must stay consistent.
- [shape-up-write-the-pitch](entries/shape-up-write-the-pitch.md): "Write the Pitch" (Shape Up, chapter 6) — Ryan Singer, Basecamp · artifact/document · jobs: pm-008 · context: fixed time budget, small team, product company · use when: the team works in fixed time budgets and the question is "what fits in the time we'll spend".
- [slack-logo-2019](entries/slack-logo-2019.md): Slack logo and identity refresh — Pentagram (Michael Bierut, with Britt Cobb, Daisy Lee, Abby Matousek) with Slack's in-house team, 2019-01 · artifact/visual · jobs: brd-010 · context: scaleup, software, screen-first, existing equity to keep · use when: refreshing a mark people already recognise, especially one that breaks on non-white backgrounds.
- [slack-logo-announcement-2019](entries/slack-logo-announcement-2019.md): "Say hello, new logo" (Slack's rationale post) — Slack, 2019-01 · artifact/document · jobs: brd-010, brd-050 · context: public rebrand announcement, existing users · use when: writing the public rationale for a logo change (brd-050).
- [tob-curl-threatmodel-2022](entries/tob-curl-threatmodel-2022.md): cURL Threat Model — Trail of Bits for the Linux Foundation, 2022-12 · artifact/document · jobs: sec-002 · context: widely embedded library and CLI, open source · use when: threat-modelling a whole system or library (sec-002).
- [tob-homebrew-2023](entries/tob-homebrew-2023.md): Homebrew Security Assessment — Trail of Bits (William Woodruff, Sam Alws, William Tan) for OTF, 2023-08 (review); 2024-07-26 (comprehensive report) · artifact/document · jobs: sec-005 · context: package manager, installer, CLI that runs third-party code, CI/CD · use when: auditing an installer, package manager or any tool that runs or writes third-party content.
- [working-backwards-pr-faq](entries/working-backwards-pr-faq.md): Working Backwards PR/FAQ instructions and template — Colin Bryar and Bill Carr (Working Backwards) · artifact/document · jobs: pm-009 · context: new product or big bet, needs leadership buy-in · use when: the idea is a new product or a bet that needs a yes from leadership.
- [brand-new](entries/brand-new.md): Brand New (UnderConsideration) — UnderConsideration · source/visual · jobs: brd-006, brd-010, brd-003, brd-050 · context: any
- [logobook](entries/logobook.md): Logobook — Logobook · source/visual · jobs: brd-006, brd-003 · context: any
- [cloudflare-security-audit-skill](entries/cloudflare-security-audit-skill.md): Cloudflare security-audit skill — Cloudflare, 2026-09 (last push) · tool/code · jobs: sec-005 · context: agent-run audit, parallel subagents
- [codeql](entries/codeql.md): CodeQL — GitHub · tool/code · jobs: sec-005 · context: supported compiled and interpreted languages, data-flow bugs
